summary: Consolidated the task 16.4 jellyfin-expert modal-on-change research spike into the task record. This is a research/decision task: no product code or tests were required or added, so implementation_complete/tests_complete reflect that the task deliverable (the spike decision, recorded) is complete and that the unchanged build/suite were run to confirm no regression, not that code was implemented. The spike note (produced on the pinned Jellyfin 12.0 host by the jellyfin-expert agent) is persisted at docs/research/jellyfin-expert/modal-notification-api.json and was read in full: the pinned bundled web client defines window.Dashboard; Dashboard.alert({title, message}) is the only single-button modal (Dashboard.alert('text') is a non-modal toast, Dashboard.confirm(...) is a two-button modal, Dashboard.showMessage does not exist); Dashboard.processPluginConfigurationUpdateResult() only hides loading and shows the SettingsSaved toast; the page is injected into the client document so the inline script shares window.Dashboard/ApiClient; the shim is public but potentially unstable (in-source TODO to remove it), web-only, and not a server ABI; confirmation is pinned-asset/source-level, not live-browser. Decision recorded for task 16.5 (not implemented here): call window.Dashboard.alert({title, message}) inside the successful ApiClient.updatePluginConfiguration(...) .then after Dashboard.processPluginConfigurationUpdateResult, conditionally on a restart-required value changing, with a fail-open guard (window.Dashboard presence check plus swallowing try/catch) and plain-text message; the task 16.3 always-present note text stays the authoritative fail-open behavior. Recorded in docs/architecture/06-configuration-and-persisted-state.md and docs/changelog/v1.2.0.md; state.json/PLANS.md updated. No modal, classification, note-text, save-path, persisted-state, endpoint, or dependency change. One out-of-scope repository documentation discrepancy found by the spike (docs/testing/jellyfin-12-musl-test-host.md states the pinned musl archive does not ship the web client, but the archive contains jellyfin/jellyfin-web/, 2363 entries; --nowebclient only means the live matrix does not serve it) was not edited and is flagged for the phase's documentation sweep (task 16.6).
